subject: Insurance
title: Australia's Black Summer
description: A short lesson to help you apply Australia's Black Summer.

hook.text: Australia's 2019-2020 Black Summer burned 46 million acres, destroyed 3,000 homes, and killed a billion animals.

buildup.text: Insurance claims reached $2.3 billion Australian dollars. Many rural homeowners had no coverage at all.

discovery.text: After Black Summer, Australian insurers raised premiums 28% in fire-prone areas. Some communities became uninsurable.

twist.text: The government considered a reinsurance pool for cyclones but not bushfires.

climax.text: Black Summer showed that insurance retreat happens everywhere fire risk grows faster than pricing adapts.

punchline.text: 46 million acres, premiums up 28%. Fire risk outpaces coverage.

quiz.question: How much acreage burned in Australia's Black Summer?
